answer: Require every agent to forge its identity from a bonded, slashable stake plus a public history of completed work: before it can earn, it must lock collateral and build a verifiable record that cannot be copied to a new account. A fresh identity starts with zero trust, so an attacker who tries to wander in with a hundred clones must fund and age each one separately, while an onyx-hard audit trail makes duplicate work visible and slashable.
